welcome: [1mpi-git[0m stages, writes and commits from inside pi, and a quick commit runs in the background while you keep typing.
This is real pi with the extension. The model is scripted, so it knows a few prompts and needs no key.
pi opens by itself in a small sample repository. Press the buttons above, in order:
add a --json flag     the agent edits a file and runs it
/git                  the staging view: space stages a file, Esc closes it
/git-quick-commit     stages everything, writes the message and commits
Change the theme at the top right and pi follows it.
